name: Napkor (Hungary)
description: White field with a red vertical stripe at the hoist edge and a blue vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Napkor (a crowned quartered blue and red shield with a sabre, scales, a star and an eagle, with a helm and red and blue mantling) above the name NAPKOR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Napkor arms with crown, helm and mantling
